title: One file per language
changes: The Summary step reads in Hebrew: what can be made from the story, the family tree, the map, the timeline, the photographs, and the answers gathered so far.

All interface text now lives in app/src/i18n/locales/*.json — one plain file per language, keyed by the English. Translating no longer means touching TypeScript, and adding a language is one new file plus three lines of code.

docs/i18n/TRANSLATION.md lists every string in the site with the screen it appears on, what each language says, and the file it comes from. It is rebuilt by scripts/i18n-catalog.mjs before every deploy.

The catalog separates three kinds of gap: never translated, translated but still printed as English by its component, and left over from text that no longer exists. Hebrew now has no gaps of the first kind.
Signing in and out, the version panel and the people filter were translated but never wired up. They are now.
